signature.name: VTask.map
signature.type: {C : Type u} -> [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] -> [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms C] -> {K K' : ChainComplex C ℕ} -> {L L' : CochainComplex C ℕ} -> (h : CochainComplex.ConnectData K L) -> (h' : CochainComplex.ConnectData K' L') -> (fK : K ⟶ K') -> (fL : L ⟶ L') -> (f_comm : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (fK.f 0) h'.d₀ = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp h.d₀ (fL.f 0)) -> h.cochainComplex ⟶ h'.cochainComplex

conventions.statement: At degree ofNat n (i.e., a non-negative integer n), the component of VTask.map h h' fK fL f_comm is fL.f n.
conventions.note: Follows from the cochain-complex half of the connected complex covering non-negative degrees.

conventions.statement: At degree negSucc n (i.e., the negative integer -(n+1)), the component of VTask.map h h' fK fL f_comm is fK.f n.
conventions.note: Follows from the chain-complex half of the connected complex covering strictly negative degrees.

conventions.statement: The commutativity of the morphism at the seam between degree negSucc 0 and ofNat 0 is supplied by the hypothesis f_comm.
conventions.note: This is the only degree where the two halves interact and an explicit compatibility condition is required.

facts.statement: ∀ {C : Type*} [CategoryTheory.Category C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms C] {K K' : ChainComplex C ℕ} {L L' : CochainComplex C ℕ} (h : CochainComplex.ConnectData K L) (h' : CochainComplex.ConnectData K' L') (fK : K ⟶ K') (fL : L ⟶ L') (f_comm : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (fK.f 0) h'.d₀ = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp h.d₀ (fL.f 0)), VTask.map h h' fK fL f_comm ∈ (Set.univ : Set (h.cochainComplex ⟶ h'.cochainComplex))

facts.statement: ∀ {C : Type*} [CategoryTheory.Category C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms C] {K K' : ChainComplex C ℕ} {L L' : CochainComplex C ℕ} (h : CochainComplex.ConnectData K L) (h' : CochainComplex.ConnectData K' L') (fK : K ⟶ K') (fL : L ⟶ L') (f_comm : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (fK.f 0) h'.d₀ = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp h.d₀ (fL.f 0)), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ((VTask.map h h' fK fL f_comm).f (Int.negSucc 0)) h'.d₀ = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp h.d₀ ((VTask.map h h' fK fL f_comm).f (Int.ofNat 0))
